items.description: An annotation on a drawing, as annotation.list and the annotation operations report it. Positions in sheet mm; dimension values in model mm (or degrees).

name.description: Its name in its view (or on its sheet), as SOLIDWORKS names it.

reference.description: Its reference (r1.annotation.…). It names the annotation by its sheet, view and name: one deleted, or whose view is renamed or deleted, no longer resolves. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

kind.description: dimension, note, centre_mark, centre_line, datum, gtol or other.

view.description: The view it belongs to; absent for one on the sheet itself.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

position.description: Where it is on the sheet, sheet mm (its text's position); absent when SOLIDWORKS gives none.

text.description: A note's text as shown, with linked properties resolved; absent for other kinds.

linked_text.description: A note's text as written, with any $PRP:"…" links unresolved; absent for other kinds.

dimension_kind.description: A dimension's kind: linear, horizontal, vertical, radius, diameter or angle; absent for another kind of dimension, or another annotation.

value.description: A dimension's value: model mm, or degrees for an angle.

dimension_name.description: A dimension's name: the model's (D1@Sketch2) for a model dimension, the drawing's (RD1@Drawing View1) for a reference dimension.

model_dimension.description: For a dimension: true for one of the model's (it drives the model, and is changed with dimension.set on the model), false for a reference dimension made on the drawing.

characteristic.description: Its geometric characteristic; absent when SOLIDWORKS gives one the add-in does not name.

tolerance_mm.description: Its tolerance, mm; absent when its text is not a number.

diameter.description: True when the tolerance carries the diameter symbol (Ø): a cylindrical tolerance zone.

material_condition.description: The tolerance's material condition; absent when SOLIDWORKS gives one the add-in does not name.

datums.description: Its datum references, primary first (up to three); empty for none.

items.description: An entity of a model as one drawing view shows it: the view, and the entity in exactly one of the forms the model tools take (a reference issued in the view's model, a {component, entity} pair, or a name such as Boss-Extrude1 or Axis1@pin-1). It is resolved in the view's model and selected through that view.

view.description: The view: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

reference.description: A reference issued in the view's model (model.find, view.entities), alone. One of reference or entity.

component.description: With entity in an assembly view: the component, by reference or name; entity is then a reference issued in the component's own part, or a name there.

entity.description: A name in the view's model (Boss-Extrude1, front, Axis1@pin-1), or with component an entity of that component. One of reference or entity.

attached.description: The model entities it is attached to, each as its view shows it (view and the reference issued in the view's model; reference is absent when SOLIDWORKS gives none). Empty when it is attached to none.

annotations.description: Each annotation brought, as read back.

items.description: A model dimension brought onto the drawing, checked against the model.

annotation.description: The annotation's name in its view.

view.description: The view it was brought into.

dimension.description: The model's name for it, as dimension.set takes it (D1@Sketch2).

value.description: Its value on the drawing: model mm, or degrees for an angle.

model_value.description: Its value in the model, which the drawing's equals.

dimensions.description: Each model dimension brought, its value on the drawing checked against the model's.

duplicates.description: Model dimensions shown in more than one view, each as "D1@Sketch2 in Drawing View1, Drawing View2": reported, not removed.

removed.description: How many annotations SOLIDWORKS put into views not asked for, which were deleted again.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

name.description: Its name, for example Sketch3 or Line2.

kind.description: What it is: feature, sketch, sketch_entity, sketch_point, dimension, plane, axis or point; component or mate in an assembly; sheet or view on a drawing.

reference.description: Its persistent reference; absent when SOLIDWORKS gives none. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

created.description: What it made (sheets, views, annotations), in the order it made them.

items.description: A value a model-changing operation edited.

name.description: What was edited, for example D1@Sketch1.

property.description: Which of its properties: value, or suppressed.

before.description: Its value before, with its unit, for example 40 mm.

after.description: Its value after, with its unit.

changed.description: What it edited, each with its value before and after.

views_before.description: Views before the change, on every sheet.

views_after.description: Views after the change, on every sheet.

annotations_before.description: Annotations before the change, on every sheet and in every view.

annotations_after.description: Annotations after the change, on every sheet and in every view.

items.description: A model a drawing shows, as it is in memory.

dirty_before.description: True when it had unsaved changes before the change.

dirty_after.description: True when it has unsaved changes after the change.

rebuild_errors_before.description: How many of its features had a rebuild error before the change.

rebuild_errors_after.description: How many of its features have a rebuild error after the change.

models.description: Each model the drawing shows, before and after: unsaved changes and rebuild errors, which must not have changed.

not_at_rest.description: Set only when the drawing could not be put back at rest after the change: the view SOLIDWORKS keeps activated, or what failed in letting go of it. The change itself stands. Ask the user to double-click the sheet outside every view. A failed change reports the same in its error's details as not_at_rest.

change.description: What changed in the drawing: created holds each annotation brought; models each model shown, unchanged.
